title: Problem
问题
html:
Vision-language models usually default to linear chain-of-thought reasoning, even though some visual problems are better solved with branching tree structures or graph-like aggregation. This mismatch can reduce reasoning accuracy and produce unnecessarily long outputs, increasing inference cost.

STELAR-VISION therefore studies whether a VLM can learn to select a suitable reasoning topology for each problem. It combines synthetic chain, tree, and graph reasoning data with supervised and preference-based post-training, while separately encouraging shorter correct responses.

现有视觉语言模型通常默认使用线性的思维链推理，但不同视觉问题未必适合同一种结构：部分任务需要分支比较，另一些任务需要综合多个关系。始终采用思维链可能降低复杂问题的正确率，还会产生重复、冗长的推理过程，增加推理时间和 token 成本。

STELAR-VISION 因此研究模型能否根据具体问题，自适应选择链、树或图结构进行推理。论文通过合成多拓扑视觉推理数据，结合监督微调、偏好优化和短回应训练，同时改善推理正确性与输出效率。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
STELAR-VISION makes the suitability of a reasoning topology an explicit supervision signal rather than treating every problem as chain-of-thought. Its TopoAug pipeline generates chain-, tree-, and graph-structured responses, labels response correctness and topology-level effectiveness, and uses these records for supervised and preference-based post-training.

The authors release STELAR-topo_vision_reasoning_preference_123k, a 123K visual-reasoning preference dataset intended to teach models which topology produces more accurate and efficient reasoning for a given image–question pair.

STELAR-VISION 的核心贡献是把“某种推理拓扑是否适合当前问题”变成显式监督信号，而不是默认所有视觉问题都采用思维链。其 TopoAug 流程为同一图像问题生成链、树和图三类推理，标注每条回应是否正确，并统计不同拓扑在该问题上的有效程度。

作者同时开放 STELAR-topo_vision_reasoning_preference_123k，包含约 123K 条视觉推理偏好数据，可用于训练模型比较不同拓扑回应，并学习在给定图像—问题输入下选择更准确、更高效的推理结构。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Select visual reasoning questions. The pipeline starts from MATH-V and VLM-S2H, which contain image–text mathematical and logical reasoning problems.
  2. Generate multiple topologies. Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct and GPT-4o-mini repeatedly answer each question using chain, tree, and graph prompts.
  3. Assign outcome and topology labels. Each response receives a binary correctness label; each topology receives a question-specific score equal to its proportion of correct responses.
  4. Filter SFT data. The authors balance easy, medium, and hard questions, retain correct responses, and use a 7B outcome reward model for rejection sampling.
  5. Construct preference pairs. Correct or topology-preferred responses become winners, while less effective or incorrect responses become losers for SimPO training.
  6. Apply Frugal Learning. Short and correct responses are preferred over incorrect or excessively long outputs to reduce reasoning length.

1. 选择视觉推理问题。 作者从 MATH-V 和 VLM-S2H 获取包含图像、题目和标准答案的数学与逻辑问题。
  2. 生成多种推理拓扑。 Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct 和 GPT-4o-mini 分别按照链、树、图提示词，为同一问题多次生成回应。
  3. 标注结果与拓扑。 每条回应根据最终答案获得二元正确性标签；每种拓扑的得分等于它在该问题上的正确回应比例。
  4. 筛选 SFT 数据。 流程平衡简单、中等和困难问题，仅保留正确回应，并由 7B outcome reward model 进行 rejection sampling。
  5. 构造偏好对。 正确或更适合当前问题的回应成为 winner，错误或效果较差的回应成为 loser，用于 SimPO。
  6. 实施 Frugal Learning。 将简短且正确的回应设为偏好目标，并惩罚错误或过长回应，以降低推理长度。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The main comparison uses Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct as the base model and evaluates on MATH-V and VLM-S2H. STELAR-VISION reaches 28.0% overall in-distribution accuracy, compared with 18.3% for the base model and 23.7% for equally sized Chain-Only training. This corresponds to gains of 9.7 and 4.3 percentage points, respectively.

The same model is also evaluated on five out-of-distribution benchmarks and consistently improves over the base model. Frugal Learning reduces output length by 18.1% while preserving comparable accuracy. These results support topology-aware training under the reported Qwen2-VL setup, but do not prove that the generated topology labels represent the model’s actual internal reasoning.

核心对比使用 Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct 作为基础模型，并在 MATH-V 与 VLM-S2H 上评测。基础模型的分布内总体准确率为 18.3%，使用等量线性思维链数据训练的 Chain-Only 为 23.7%，完整 STELAR-VISION 达到 28.0%，分别取得 9.7 和 4.3 个百分点的提升。

论文还在 Geometry3K、We-Math、PolyMath、SciBench 和 LogicVista 五个分布外 benchmark 上测试，STELAR-VISION 均优于基础模型。Frugal Learning 将输出长度减少 18.1%，同时保持接近的准确率。这支持多拓扑训练在当前 Qwen2-VL 配置下有效，但不能证明外显格式等同于模型真实内部推理结构。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Chain-of-thought training normally supplies one linear solution structure for every problem. Tree-of-Thought and Graph-of-Thought expose alternative structures, but they are commonly used as manually specified inference procedures rather than as instance-level supervision for vision-language model post-training.

STELAR-VISION changes the data object: each visual question is paired with multiple topology-conditioned responses, response-level correctness, and topology-level effectiveness. The novelty is not chain, tree, graph reasoning, SFT, or SimPO individually, but automatically generating and comparing these structures so the model can learn which topology fits each visual problem.

传统思维链训练通常为每道题提供一条线性解答。Tree-of-Thought 和 Graph-of-Thought 虽然引入了分支或图结构，但更多被用作人工指定的推理流程，较少作为视觉语言模型后训练中的逐样本监督，模型也通常不会学习何时使用哪种结构。

STELAR-VISION 真正改变的是数据对象：同一视觉问题对应多种拓扑回应、每条回应的正确性标签，以及不同拓扑在该问题上的有效性分数。其新意不在链、树、图、SFT 或 SimPO 本身，而在自动生成并比较这些结构，使模型学习问题与推理拓扑之间的匹配关系。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
First, topology labels are derived from the accuracy of responses generated under topology-specific prompts. A response formatted as a tree or graph does not prove that the model internally followed that reasoning structure. Reuse should therefore test whether removing or perturbing the visible topology format changes performance.

Second, correctness is mainly determined from final answers, so a response with flawed intermediate reasoning can still enter training if it reaches the right result. The synthetic data also depends on Qwen2-VL-7B and GPT-4o-mini and focuses on visual mathematics and logic. Reuse should audit intermediate reasoning and test other domains and generators.

第一，拓扑标签来自不同拓扑提示下生成回应的最终正确率。一个回应在文本形式上呈现为树或图，并不能证明模型内部确实按照对应拓扑完成推理；模型也可能只学习标题、缩进或格式模式。复用时应删除或扰动外显拓扑标记，检查性能是否仍然保持。

第二，样本正确性主要依据最终答案判断，因此中间步骤存在错误但偶然得到正确答案的回应仍可能进入训练集。合成数据还依赖 Qwen2-VL-7B 和 GPT-4o-mini，并集中于视觉数学与逻辑任务。复用前应抽样审计中间推理，并测试其他领域、模型和生成策略。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Researchers with visual questions and verifiable answers can reuse TopoAug to generate chain, tree, and graph responses, label their outcomes, and construct topology-aware SFT or preference data. Success should be checked through accuracy, output length, and comparison with an equal-sized chain-only dataset.

The released 123K preference data can also train topology-aware reward or policy models and support studies of reasoning efficiency. The method is less suitable when answers cannot be reliably verified, when reasoning topology has no meaningful textual representation, or when intermediate-step correctness matters more than the final answer.

如果研究者已有带图像、问题和可验证标准答案的数据，可以复用 TopoAug：分别生成链、树和图结构回应，检查最终答案，为每条回应和每种拓扑赋值，再构造拓扑感知的 SFT 数据或偏好对。效果应通过准确率、平均输出长度以及与等规模 Chain-Only 数据的对照确认。

开放的 123K 偏好数据也可用于训练拓扑感知奖励模型、偏好策略，或研究视觉推理中的准确率—长度权衡。当任务答案无法可靠验证、推理结构难以用文本表示，或中间步骤正确性比最终答案更重要时，不能直接沿用该流程。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Positioning: STELAR-VISION addresses the mismatch between one-size-fits-all chain-of-thought and visual problems requiring different reasoning structures.
  2. Method handle: Multi-topology generation, final-answer labeling, topology scoring, outcome-reward filtering, SimPO, and short-correct preference construction determine performance.
  3. Artifact handle: The released dataset contains approximately 123K visual-reasoning preference records covering chain, tree, and graph structures.
  4. Evidence anchor: Overall in-distribution accuracy rises from 18.3% for the base model and 23.7% for Chain-Only to 28.0%; Frugal Learning reduces length by 18.1%.
  5. Reuse decision: It is suitable for verifiable visual reasoning, but topology-format shortcuts and incorrect intermediate steps must be audited before reuse.

1. 一句话定位：STELAR-VISION 解决统一使用线性思维链与不同视觉问题需要不同推理结构之间的不匹配。
  2. 方法抓手：多拓扑生成、最终答案标注、拓扑得分、outcome reward 筛选、SimPO 和“短且正确”偏好是关键环节。
  3. 数据抓手：开放数据包含约 123K 条视觉推理偏好记录，覆盖链、树和图三种外显推理结构。
  4. 证据锚点：分布内总体准确率从基础模型的 18.3% 和 Chain-Only 的 23.7% 提升到 28.0%；Frugal Learning 将长度降低 18.1%。
  5. 复用决定：适合答案可验证的视觉推理任务，但复用前必须检查拓扑格式捷径和“答案正确、过程错误”的样本。
